content: In an action movie, there’s nothing worse than an underwhelming final battle. While Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings was one of the best post- Avengers: Endgame movies of the Marvel Cinematic Universe, its final battle became a disconnected CGI fest that was hard to follow. For Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Secret of the Ooze, the sequel’s fun energy was undermined when a mutated Shredder died after collapsing a dock onto himself without a fight ever even starting.
